info.name: Arthur GenAI Engine Agent Discovery Traces API

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Column to sort results by.

params.name: include_spans
params.description: Include flat list of spans for each trace. Defaults to false for performance.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort the results (asc/desc)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Page size. Default is 10. Must be greater than 0 and less than 5000.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number

params.name: task_ids
params.description: Task IDs to filter on. At least one is required.

params.name: trace_ids
params.description: Trace IDs to filter on. Optional.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Inclusive start date in ISO8601 string format. Use local time (not UTC).

params.name: end_time
params.description: Exclusive end date in ISO8601 string format. Use local time (not UTC).

params.name: tool_name
params.description: Return only results with this tool name.

params.name: span_types
params.description: Span types to filter on. Optional. Valid values: AGENT, CHAIN, EMBEDDING, EVALUATOR, GUARDRAIL, LLM, PROMPT, RERANKER, RETRIEVER, TOOL, UNKNOWN

params.name: annotation_score
params.description: Filter by trace annotation score (0 or 1).

params.name: annotation_type
params.description: Filter by trace annotation type (i.e. 'human' or 'continuous_eval').

params.name: continuous_eval_run_status
params.description: Filter by trace annotation run status (e.g. 'passed', 'failed', etc.).

params.name: continuous_eval_name
params.description: Filter by continuous eval name.

params.name: span_ids
params.description: Span IDs to filter on. Optional.

params.name: session_ids
params.description: Session IDs to filter on. Optional.

params.name: user_ids
params.description: User ID substrings to filter on (case-insensitive). Returns results where user_id contains any of the provided values. Optional.

params.name: span_name
params.description: Return only results with this span name.

params.name: span_name_contains
params.description: Return only results where span name contains this substring.

params.name: status_code
params.description: Status codes to filter on. Optional. Valid values: Ok, Error, Unset.

params.name: query_relevance_eq
params.description: Equal to this value.

params.description: Greater than or equal to this value.

params.description: Include traces originating from Arthur experiments. Defaults to true.

items.docs: Get lightweight trace metadata for browsing/filtering operations. Returns metadata only without spans or metrics for fast performance. Set include_spans=true to include flat list of spans for each trace.

info.name: Get Overview of Traces for each Task

items.docs: Get overview of traces for each task including trace count, total tokens, and success rate.

info.name: Get Time-Series Overview Data for a Task

items.docs: Get time-bucketed trace metrics (count, tokens, cost, success rate) for a single task.
Get complete trace tree with existing metrics (no computation). Returns full trace structure with spans.
Compute all missing metrics for trace spans on-demand. Returns full trace tree with computed metrics.
